en:
Now, if you don't mind, I'd like a moment to speak with
you about Watamin-chi.
Oh, of course! Please do!

Watamin-chi is a charcoal grill restaurant, and so, as you
can imagine, our menu is quite different from that of
Watami.

We're still a fairly new company, and we'd love to have
someone with a fresh, youthful image like you for our poster
girl.
Thank you very much. That's very kind of you to say.

We wish the same for our menu items, as well. We put quite a
bit of thought into naming them.

For example, we have a freshly squeezed orange juice
cocktail with orange slices, appropriately called "Spaceship
from Planet Orange." Cute, don't you think?
(Oh, that's right. Miss Yamaura told me about that, too.)

And we have an interesting drink made from energy drink,
peach, and red bayberry. Let's see. What was it called
again...?
Oh, that one? I think I know.
That's the "Red, White, and Blue Cow Now," right?

No, that's not it, although I think it's something along
those lines. What was it, now...?

It's "Red, Red, Fuzzy Cow Pow." You're the Watamin-chi
President. How could you forget your own company's menu item?
That's a "Red, Red, Fuzzy Cow Pow," right?

Yes, that's it! I'm impressed that you knew it! Thank you
very much!

Unbelievable. You're the Watamin-chi president. How could
you forget a thing like that?
That's a "Red and Orange Cow Town," right?
Hmm. That sounds so close! Agh, what in the world was it?

It's "Red, Red, Fuzzy Cow Pow." You're the Watamin-chi
president. How could you forget your own company's speciality?

Well, that sort of thing happens to the best of us from time
to time.

You're the president! That should never happen, not even
once.

Excuse me, but I'm not finished speaking with Haruka-chan
just yet. I'll thank you to keep quiet.
Well, excuse me.

Now then, Haruka-chan, say we've created a special beverage
in your honor.
What would be the perfect name for this drink?
A drink made in my honor? Well, let's see...

I'm a little embarrassed to suggest it myself, but how about
"Haruka Sweet 17"?

Well, isn't that a lovely name? Very fitting for a cute
young idol such as yourself!

Hmm. That sounds like it would be well-suited for Watami's
as well. I imagine it would be very popular with the ladies!

I'm a little embarrassed to suggest it, but how about
"Haruka Sakura"?

Oh, I see! Cherry blossoms, is it? A drink that calls forth
the image of spring. I like it!

I'm a little embarrassed to suggest it, but how about
"Haruka Harmonica Bazooka"?

Oh, that's wonderful! That's just the sort of name we love
at Watamin-chi!

Well done, Haruka-chan. I admire the way you managed to
somehow adjust your thinking to coincide with Watamin-chi's
questionable taste.

"Questionable"!? You couldn't have picked something less
harsh!?
Unfortunately, that's the only word that comes to mind.

I'll have you know that our "taste" is to be fun and silly
on purpose! We have many loyal and enthusiastic customers
because of it!

I'm simply complimenting Haruka-chan on her most excellent
answer. We'd love for her to help develop names for our menu
items as well!

Must you constantly derail the conversation? We're talking
about Watamin-chi's menu, thank you very much!

But wasn't it you who said just a few moments ago that this
was a joint audition? You aren't the only company president
in the room, you know.

Ahem! Perhaps, but be that as it may, we've now come to the
interesting part of the audition.
Yes, I must agree.

That concludes the interview portion of the audition. Now,
if you wouldn't mind, Haruka-chan, we'd like you to show us
your dancing.

I've been looking forward to this. I can't believe we get
our own private Haruka Sawamura performance!

I feel the same way! And once the dance portion is over,
we'll be ready to give you our answer.
All right. I'll do my very best!
Hey, me first! Heheh. Wait till the boys see this!
Who shall I make this out to?
Can ya do "Yasuhiro Yamasaki"?
All right. Let's see...
Here you are. Did I get it right?

No, no, no! It was supposed to be "Yasuhiro Yamasaki"! You
put "Yasuhiko Yamakasi"!
Wha⑬? I did?

I mean, ya got a few letters right, but that's not how you
spell my first or last name!
I'm so sorry! Please forgive me!

Yup! You got it! Hey, thanks. The boys're gonna be so
jealous!
You're very welcome!

No, no, no! It's supposed to be "Yasuhiro Yamasaki"! You put
"Yasuko Yasakami"!
No, no, no! It was supposed to be "Yasuhiro Yamasaki"! You put "Yasuhiko Yakasaki"!
Wha⑬? I did!?
No, no, no! It's supposed to be "Yasuhiro Yamasaki"!
Hm? What did I write?
You put "Yazuhiro Yamazaki"!
I'm next, dearie!
Who should I make it out to?

Make it out to "Misaki Takahashi." Great name, huh? Good
thing I live up to it!
Wait a second! Weren't ya listenin'!?

I said "Misaki Takahashi." You wrote "Misako Tobayashi"!
That's way off!
Might wanna clean out your ears next time!

Ah, I see what ya did. Well, ya got a couple letters right
at least.
I said "Misaki Takahashi." You wrote "Mizaki Takahachi"!

Yeah, that's exactly it! Thank you, Haruka! I'll be rootin'
for ya, girl!
What's this? Weren't ya listenin'!?

I said "Misaki Takahashi." You wrote "Mizaki Tabakashi"!
That's way off!
Oh! Was that wrong?
I said "Misaki Takahashi." You wrote "Masaki Tobayakashi".
That's way off!

This is so exciting! I can't believe I'm going to get your
autograph! I'm a huge fan!
And who am I making this out to?
It's "Toshikazu Sekiguchi."

Well, not exactly. I said "Toshikazu Sekiguchi,"  but you
wrote "Tochikazu Sekigushi."
Oh, I'm sorry! Please forgive me!
I probably didn't say it clearly enough...
Well, that's kind of close. You were only off by a little.

I said "Toshikazu Sekiguchi," but you wrote "Toshiyazu
Segikuchi."
Oh, I'm so sorry!

Don't feel bad, Haruka-chan. I probably didn't say it
clearly enough.

Yes, that's right! This is beautiful! I'll treasure it
forever!

Well, not exactly. I said "Toshikazu Sekiguchi,"  but you
wrote "Toshigazu Sekigushi."
Hmm. Not exactly...

My name's Toshikazu Sekiguchi, but you wrote "Toshikazu
Sekigushi."

That's all right, Haruka! Don't feel bad. I probably didn't
say it clearly enough.
My turn! My whole family always watches you on TV, you know!
Thank you very much! Who am I making this out to?
Oh, right! Could you make it out to "Hideaki Ishikawa"?
That's right! Just like the famous action star!

My favorite of his is that one where he lays the smackdown
on all those street thugs!
Man, I wish I was as cool as him!
I don't think I've ever seen that movie.
Well, thanks for the autograph, Haruka-chan!

Huh? You've never heard of Hideaki Ishikawa? He's super
famous. We have the exact same name.
But you wrote "Hideaki Ishiwaka."
I guess you're too young to know his movies...

Huh? You've never heard of Hideaki Ishikawa? He's super
famous! We have the exact same name.

But it looks like you wrote "Hideki Ishikawa." Oh well,
that's all right. At least I got your autograph!
Did I? I'm so sorry!
But it looks like you wrote "Hideaki Ichikawa."

Huh? You don't know Hideaki Ishikawa? He's super famous.
We have the exact same name.
Oh! I'm so sorry! What did I write?

You wrote "Hideki Ishiwaka." Oh well, that's all right.
At least I got your autograph!
It's my turn! I saw you on TV!
You did? Thanks for watching! What's your name?
It's "Akiharu Fukushima."
Wow! That's a pretty complex name.
You really know how to spell that?
Yup! It's my own name, isn't it?
Right, I guess that makes sense.
That's not what I saaaid!
You wrote "Akiharu Fukujima." I said "Akiharu Fukushima."
Oh no! I'm really sorry!
Yeah! That's perfect! Woohoo!
Was it hard to spell your name when you were first learning to write?

Nah, it was easy! What kind of dummy would I be if I
couldn't write my own name!?

That's not it! You wrote "Arikaru Fushujima." I said
"Akiharu Fukushima."
I mean, it's not that hard, is it? How were you so off?

That's not it! You wrote "Arikaru Fushukima." I said
"Akiharu Fukushima."
Nooo! That's not right!
Oh, I'm sorry! What did I get wrong?

You wrote "Akihime Fushujima." I said "Akiharu Fukushima."
And "Akihime" is a girl's name! How do you mess it up that
bad?

All right, people. You all got your autographs! This session
is now officially over!
Like I said before, who made you king!?
Thank you very much for your time, Haruka-chan.

Thank you all very much! I hope you'll all continue to
support me!
Of course we will!
Good luck, Haruka-chan!
You're the best!
I'll be watchin' ya on TV!

We all wanted to thank you, so we all pitched in and got you
this. We're sorry for swarming you earlier.
We'd better split before anybody else shows up.

All right, people! Let's give Haruka-chan a big round of
applause!

You want the whole town to come runnin' over!? Might as well
get on the bullhorn!
Oh, right. Sorry...

Thank you all very much! I just want to say I really am
sorry to the people whose names I got wrong.
Aw, don't worry about it!
Yeah, don't feel bad about a little thing like that!
Wow! Thanks so much!

All right, people! We all walk away like nothing ever
happened! No smiling! No chit-chat! None of it!

Slow your roll there, your highness! Let's just walk away
like normal!

I'm really sorry, everyone. I got all your names wrong...
Oh, I feel so awful!
Hey, these things happen.
Just try a little harder next time, Haruka-chan!

Don't let all that singin' distract you from your studies,
ya hear?
You got a <Color:8>Staminan X<Color:Default>.
Aw, thank you very much!
Hey! You're Haruka-chan, aren't you!?

It is you! I knew it! I'm a big fan of yours! I always watch
you on TV! I can't believe I'm seeing you out and about like
this!
Haruka-chan!? From the Princess League!?
No way! Ya gotta be kiddin' me!
Haruka-chan is here!?
Hey! They're sayin' Haruka-chan is over here!
You get your eyes checked any time recently? She's right there!
Hello...

Oh, man! I'm sorry, Haruka-chan. Me and my big mouth. Look
at all these people!
No, no. It's all right.

Really? You mean it? In that case, could I have your
autograph?
Hey, I want an autograph, too!
Haruka-chan, me too!
Can I have your autograph, too, Haruka-chan?
Okay, everybody. Just calm down! Don't mob the poor girl!

Whaddya talkin' about? You're the bulb who came up with the
bright idea!
You'll be a good girl and give us your autograph, now, won't ya?
Of course! I'd be happy to give everyone my autograph!

Great! Okay, people, listen up! Please form an orderly line!
We don't want to block traffic, here. Wait your turn! And no
pushing!
Who died and made you king?
Okay, Haruka-chan! We're all ready for you!
All right. Thank you!
Augh! Mercy! Please! We're sorry!
Aniki, wait! Don't leave me here!
Wow, old man, you're amazing!
You know that's not my name, right? You can call me Akiyama.

Thank you, Akiyama-san. If it wasn't for you, I... I feel
so stupid for being afraid of them.
Heh, that right? Well, sorry if I cost you your friends.

No, it's okay. I was only with them because I was scared of
Emi-chan's brother.

I'm not going to have anything to do with them anymore. I'll
try my best to make new friends.

That's good. Actually, there's a girl who might be a good
start. I think she attends the same school as you.
Her name's Haruka Sawamura. You know her?
Akiyama-san, you know Haruka-chan?

Yeah, you might say that. She's so busy with being an idol
these days, she hasn't had the chance to make many friends
at school.
Mind saying hi to her? I'm sure it'd make her happy.

But she's an idol. Do you really think we could become
friends?

She's an idol, but she's also just an ordinary girl⑬and
your age, too. I'm sure she feels lonely at school with so
few friends.

Oh. I didn't think it would be like that. I'll work up some
courage and try talking to her!
I'd greatly appreciate it.
I have to go now. Thank you, Akiyama-san!
Eek! I'm sorry! No more, please...

Are you all right? I imagine you had enough of this paid
relationship nonsense.

I didn't do this because I wanted to. I didn't have a
choice!
You had no choice? You're really that desperate for money?
It wasn't about money.
Then, what was it about?
Kazumi, whaddya think you're doin'?
Emi-chan!

You tellin' me you lost a customer? We got things to do,
too, ya know? So irresponsible of you not followin' through
like that.

Ah, so these girls were making you do this. But I don't
understand. Why put up with it?
